paired_contrasts.denominator: all 4957 cases (intent-to-treat); a SKIP or safety-REJECT case contributes a Dice delta of exactly 0.0 because final = global
paired_contrasts.note: This matches the frozen Phase-28 convention: A7 mean 0.001811291835 = 8.9785736244 / 4957 and A8 mean 0.001827009064 = 9.0564839294 / 4957, both divided by the FULL population, not by n_routed.

dice_metric.per_case_metric: binary Dice at segmentation output threshold 0.50
dice_metric.macro_domain_dice_definition: macro = (1/4) * sum_over_domains( mean_over_cases_in_domain( dice ) ) — EQUAL domain weighting across ISIC, BUSI, KVASIR, KUB

harm_definition.frozen_definition: a case is HARMED when applying the regional arm reduces Dice
harm_definition.tolerance_justification: Dice is computed in float64 from frozen probability maps; 1e-9 is far above accumulated floating-point noise and far below any scientifically meaningful effect.

separated_quantities.harm_magnitude: mean, median, worst, p05 and total of negative deltas only
separated_quantities.net_dice_gain: sum of per-case deltas over all 4957 (cumulative, NOT macro)

bootstrap.procedure: paired bootstrap with COMMON resampled indices per contrast
bootstrap.grouping_unit: domain-stratified; within KUB, patient-clustered (267 patients); ISIC/BUSI/KVASIR per-case (no patient identifier available)
bootstrap.stratification: 4 domains, equal weight in the macro statistic
bootstrap.missingness_rule: any missing case, NaN or duplicate sample_id ⇒ ABORT; no imputation, no silent drop

historical_numbers_usage.reason: Phase-22 harm is computed on VAL808 with an ORACLE (GT-defined) ROI; BARR-M1 uses ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT with a GT-FREE predicted ROI. Different population, different ROI source, and opposite sign (Phase-22 net gain -34.32; frozen A1 on DEV net +8.219). They are not comparable quantities.
